title.heading: Merriwold Dental
title.subheading: A dental office website: a tooth map of all 32 teeth drawn on the server, treatments with visits, chair time and how they feel, aftercare guides, and a patients-only room.

end.heading: Built with Raytha
end.subheading: Open-source .NET CMS. Get the brief, screenshots and a one-command rebuild kit.

scenes.caption: Home: a chart of all 32 teeth, every tooth a link, and the treatment ledger with visits, chair time and how it feels
Pick tooth 30: the server lists every treatment for that tooth, with answers and notes about it
Pick a family and the teeth it covers light up
A treatment: visit by visit with chair minutes, an honest how-it-feels rating, and where in the mouth
Signed out, aftercare stays on the server
Signed in as a patient: aftercare hour by hour, then the patient room

phoneCaption.text: The same pages on a phone
